transcript.text: Can you describe your experience developing the bus-pass renewal web app for your college transport office?

I'm a final-year BTech student in computer science at a private engineering college in Coimbatore. My main project was a bus-pass renewal app for our college transport office. Before that, students stood in a queue for about two hours to renew. I built the form and payment-confirmation flow, and in the pilot semester about 900 students used it. I now want an MBA because I enjoy deciding what to build more than writing the code, and I don't have the business training for that.
